release_notes_zh:
修复：安装后启动显示「127.0.0.1 拒绝连接 / ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED」
- 0.1.3 的桌面程序以开发模式编译，启动时去连接本机开发服务器 http://127.0.0.1:1431，而不是加载打包在程序里的界面
- 0.1.4 改为生产模式编译，界面资源已嵌入程序，无需本地服务即可启动
- 0.1.3 界面无法加载，应用内自动更新也不可用，请从发布页手动安装一次 0.1.4，之后自动更新恢复正常
- 命令行与 MCP 程序同步更新版本号，truerespi --version 显示 0.1.4

说明
- 安装包由 Inno Setup 7 制作，可直接覆盖安装，用户数据保留在 %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
release_notes_en:
Fixed: the app showed "127.0.0.1 refused to connect / ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED" right after installation
- The 0.1.3 desktop build was compiled in development mode and tried to load http://127.0.0.1:1431 instead of the interface bundled into the executable
- 0.1.4 is a production build: the frontend assets are embedded in the executable, so no local server is needed
- Because the 0.1.3 window never loaded, in-app auto-update was unusable there; install 0.1.4 once from the release page and automatic updates resume afterwards
- The CLI and MCP binaries now report 0.1.4 as well

Notes
- The installer is built with Inno Setup 7 and installs over an existing copy; user data stays in %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
